clarification: The phrase No real child/PG/network/permissions actions is overbroad for the main shared suite. The shared CLI test invokes six permitted offline preflight Python children. It does not invoke a PostgreSQL server, trial/runner, pip/network or privileges actions. The separate native-FD probe is same-process only. The final guard explicitly records all six CLI children with bytecode disabled and private TMPDIR.
historical_caches: No claim is made that historical child bytecode writes did or did not occur; tracked-source hashes remain unchanged.
